headline.zh: 武康庭内老洋房咖啡馆
headline.en: Old mansion café in Wukang Court

traits.zh: 位于武康庭内老洋房，有户外与室内座位
traits.en: Housed in a historic mansion within Wukang Court, with indoor and outdoor seating

traits.zh: 招牌饮品为庭院卡布奇诺
提供早午餐、午餐、晚餐及饮料，含欧陆与美式风味
traits.en: Serves brunch, lunch, dinner, and drinks with European and American styles

traits.zh: 营业至晚间22:00，周末稍晚开门
traits.en: Closes at 10 PM, opens later on weekends

traits.zh: 服务生使用英语交流，氛围偏国际
traits.en: Staff communicate in English, giving an international vibe

focus.zh: 英语服务暗示国际氛围

energy.en: Quiet oasis in a bustling area

adventure.zh: 招牌饮品具特色但非实验性
adventure.en: Signature drink distinctive but not experimental
